# Shuttle Brief
The Rivet is a compact engineering and recovery shuttle designed to provide essential repair, fabrication, and field support capabilities at a low entry cost.
Its small hull and practical layout makes it well suited for independent engineering work, emergency repairs, and recovery operations where a larger engineering vessel is unnecessary.
[italic]Brought to you by Stonian Industries.[/italic]
